correctness.rationale: For each finite star, couple the original stationary process to a decoupled hub with the same hub resets and leaf update clocks. During [-T,0], no hub-copy events (probability of failure <=T), a common hub reset in the first half, and every leaf updated in the second half force exact full-configuration coalescence. This proves TV <=T+(n+1) exp(-theta T/2). Stationary decoupled hub-filter PDMP has zero flux, Beta(a,a) marginal with a=theta/[2(1+theta)], and Bernoulli hub conditioning. Conditional leaf-count Binomial(n,1/2+(Y-1/2)/(1+theta)) and uniform characteristic functions prove all three theta/sqrt(n) limits when theta/log n ->infinity. Integration yields S(lambda), with derivative -lambda^-2 E[A^2 phi(A/lambda)]<0 and first endpoint 1/2+1/pi. Independent exact CTMC stationary calculations for n=2..4 and beta mixture TV corroborated algebra; these do not prove asymptotic.
residual_risks: Comparison TV estimate is nonsharp; logarithmic noise criterion only sufficient. Fixed-noise/nonstar models, Bayes-optimal classifier not addressed.
